purpose: Verified public-source metadata for resuming native catalog searches for acquisition exceptions. This is not a download manifest or a determination of archival acceptance.

scope.sanitization: Only public official-source URLs and descriptive catalog metadata are retained. No browser sessions, authentication data, account identifiers, Windows paths, expiring catalog URLs, or inferred PDF URLs are included.
limitations: A zero-result native search does not establish that an order or catalog record is absent.
Historical publication or classification notes do not establish present classification or catalog availability.
Keyword and number candidates require live catalog number, date, and subject verification before a supplied ID is marked downloaded.
No progress state was modified while preparing this support file.

notes: The bounded official-source search produced numerical false positives. No alternative spelling, date, or subject was verified. The supplied year is inventory metadata, not independently verified official metadata.
